Its two slopes give the complete set-valued update map directly. For \(\eta<2\theta\), every first crossing from an outer region lands inside \((-\theta,\theta]\); all subsequent singleton steps move toward zero, and every threshold choice enters the strict inner region, so finite absorption follows for all selections. At \(\eta=2\theta\), the threshold minimizer intervals contain the opposite threshold points. For \(\eta>2\theta\), any \(c\in(\theta,\eta-	heta)\) maps uniquely to \(c-\eta<-	heta\) and uniquely back to \(c\). The frozen exact-rational script was read and is consistent with each regime but is not used as the quantified proof.

final_claim: For the scalar composite objective \(\phi(x)=\frac a2x^2+\lambda|x|\) under the exact constant-radius linearized trust-region update, the selection-robust global finite-termination region is exactly \(0<\eta<2\lambda/a\); at equality an admissible threshold two-cycle exists, and every supercritical radius has an open interval of unique exact two-cycles.
